newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-STEFFI GRAF'S FATHER FREED AFTER COURT RULING.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STEFFI GRAF'S FATHER FREED AFTER COURT RULING.

text.p: Tennis star Steffi Graf's father was released on bail on Friday after a German court trying him on tax evasion charges ruled he no longer needed to remain in custody.
Graf's lawyers said a higher court had upheld the decision made earlier by a Mannheim court that Graf could go free while it considered objections by prosecutors.

The Mannheim court set bail at five million marks ($3.32 million) and said Graf would have to report to police twice a week and receive pyschotherapy. His mental health during his time in custody has been the subject of German newspaper speculation.
Graf is accused of evading 19 million marks ($12.61 million) of tax on his daughter's earnings between 1989 and 1993.
Steffi Graf has said she knew little about her financial affairs, entrusting them to her father from the start of a career which has taken her to the number one spot in women's tennis.
